newsitem.title: USA: Cortech to reduce full-time staff to 30.
newsitem.headline: Cortech to reduce full-time staff to 30.

text.p: Cortech Inc said Thursday it would reduce the company's full-time staff from 75 to approximately 30 by the end of the current quarter.

Cortech said the downsizing follows the company's announcement on March 24 that it was planning an aggressive restructuring after receiving disappointing results from a Phase II clinical trial of Bradycor, a bradykinin antagonist, in patients with traumatic brain injury.
In that study, the drug showed no significant effect on the primary endpoint, intracranial pressure.
Cortech said its continuing research efforts will be directed principally to the discovery and preclinical development of orally bioavailable inhibitors of the protease neutrophil elastase.
